CREATE TABLE "public"."Activity" (
  "activityType" text DEFAULT 'GENERAL' NOT NULL,
  "approvalMode" text DEFAULT 'AUTO' NOT NULL,
  "attendanceMode" text DEFAULT 'OPEN_LINK' NOT NULL,
  "attendanceTokenHash" text,
  "committeeId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "individualPoints" int4 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "needsApproval" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "publicId" text NOT NULL,
  "registrationEnd" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "registrationStart" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "requireAttendanceToken" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "seasonId" text NOT NULL,
  "startsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Activity_activityType_check_ac06b6a9" CHECK ("activityType" IN ('GENERAL', 'SPORTS', 'TALK', 'WORKSHOP', 'SOCIAL', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "Activity_approvalMode_check_f4986587" CHECK ("approvalMode" IN ('AUTO', 'MANUAL')),
  CONSTRAINT "Activity_attendanceMode_check_03c32325" CHECK ("attendanceMode" IN ('OPEN_LINK')),
  CONSTRAINT "Activity_status_check_06bd9c3d" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'OPEN', 'CLOSED', 'PROCESSED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ActivityPublicIdHistory" (
  "activityId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "publicId" text NOT NULL,
  "retiredAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AppConfig" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "updatedById" text,
  "value" jsonb NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Attendance" (
  "activityId" text NOT NULL,
  "approvedAt" timestamptz,
  "approvedById" text,
  "cancelReason" text,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "memberId" text NOT NULL,
  "registeredAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "source" text DEFAULT 'LINK' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Attendance_source_check_9b2c7690" CHECK ("source" IN ('QR', 'LINK', 'ADMIN', 'IMPORT', 'MICROSOFT_FORMS')),
  CONSTRAINT "Attendance_status_check_57fe5f48" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AuditLog" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text,
  "after" jsonb,
  "before" jsonb,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entityId" text NOT NULL,
  "entityType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ip" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AuthChallenge" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "codeHash" text NOT NULL,
  "consumedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ip" text,
  "kind" text DEFAULT 'OTP' NOT NULL,
  "maxAttempts" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "AuthChallenge_kind_check_f6c16e61" CHECK ("kind" IN ('OTP', 'MAGIC_LINK'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Badge" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Badge_type_check_d9306b4a" CHECK ("type" IN ('STREAK', 'POINTS', 'TOP', 'MVP', 'LEADER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Committee" (
  "color" text DEFAULT '#1e3a5f' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Committee_status_check_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CommitteeActivityScore" (
  "activityId" text NOT NULL,
  "attendeeCredit" numeric NOT NULL,
  "committeeId" text NOT NULL,
  "computedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creditStrategy" text NOT NULL,
  "eligibleMemberCount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "frozen" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "participationRate" numeric NOT NULL,
  "seasonId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "CommitteeActivityScore_creditStrategy_check_778f09b0" CHECK ("creditStrategy" IN ('FULL_CREDIT', 'FRACTIONAL_CREDIT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."HallOfFameSeason" (
  "activeWinnerId" text,
  "committeeWinnerId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "newWinnerId" text,
  "seasonId" text NOT NULL,
  "stats" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "top3Active" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "top3Committees" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "top3New" jsonb NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."IdentityAccount" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastLoginAt" timestamptz,
  "memberId" text NOT NULL,
  "microsoftOid" text,
  "microsoftTid" text,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "IdentityAccount_provider_check_db831ec5" CHECK ("provider" IN ('EMAIL_OTP', 'MICROSOFT_ENTRA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ImportJob" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "filename" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "summary" jsonb,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Member" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "institutionalEmail" text NOT NULL,
  "memberType" text DEFAULT 'NEW' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Member_memberType_check_dd93d282" CHECK ("memberType" IN ('NEW', 'ACTIVE')),
  CONSTRAINT "Member_status_check_64177b27" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'ON_LEAVE', 'HONORARY', 'INACTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MemberBadge" (
  "awardedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "badgeId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "memberId" text NOT NULL,
  "periodKey" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "seasonId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MemberCommittee" (
  "committeeId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "leftAt" timestamptz,
  "memberId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MemberRole" (
  "committeeId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "memberId" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "MemberRole_role_check_dad004a6" CHECK ("role" IN ('MEMBER', 'COMMITTEE_LEADER', 'ADMIN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PointTransaction" (
  "activityId" text,
  "attendanceId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "memberId" text NOT NULL,
  "points" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "reversalOfId" text,
  "seasonId" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "PointTransaction_type_check_eceeaca5" CHECK ("type" IN ('ACTIVITY', 'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT', 'BONUS', 'PENALTY', 'REVERSAL'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Season" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endDate" date NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "startDate" date NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'UPCOMING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Season_status_check_ef432205" CHECK ("status" IN ('UPCOMING', 'ACTIVE', 'CLOSED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ip" text,
  "memberId" text NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
